mapper.select: SELECT q.*, IFNULL(uq.completed, FALSE) AS completed FROM careermate_quest q LEFT JOIN careermate_user_quest uq ON uq.quest_id = q.id AND uq.user_id = #{userId} WHERE q.status = '사용' ORDER BY q.id
SELECT * FROM careermate_quest ORDER BY id
SELECT * FROM careermate_quest WHERE name = #{name} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO careermate_quest (name, description, category, target_grade, exp, period, is_today, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{category}, #{targetGrade}, #{exp}, #{period}, FALSE, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT completed FROM careermate_user_quest WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND quest_id = #{questId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO careermate_user_quest (user_id, quest_id, completed, completed_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{questId}, TRUE, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE careermate_user_quest SET completed = TRUE, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND quest_id = #{questId}
mapper.select: SELECT quest_id AS questId, COUNT(*) AS count FROM careermate_user_quest WHERE completed = TRUE GROUP BY quest_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM careermate_user_quest WHERE completed = TRUE

SELECT u.name AS studentName, q.name AS questTitle, q.exp AS exp, uq.completed_at AS completedAt FROM careermate_user_quest uq JOIN careermate_student_user u ON u.id = uq.user_id JOIN careermate_quest q ON q.id = uq.quest_id WHERE uq.completed = TRUE ORDER BY uq.completed_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
